summary: Connect same-colored pixels along horizontal, vertical, or 45/135-degree diagonal paths, with neighbor pixels from the starting point following in parallel offset positions.
path: connect s1 to s2 along horizontal, vertical, or strict 45/135-degree diagonal line
trajectory: paint s.color along entire path between same-colored pixels
multi_step: Step 1: identify pairs of same-colored pixels that can connect via H/V/diagonal; Step 2: draw connecting line between them; Step 3: for each neighbor of starting pixel, draw parallel line with same offset
src2: neighbor pixels in 8-connected neighborhood of path starting point s
path2: parallel to primary path, offset by relative position of neighbor to starting pixel
